Three friends - 2 GMs and 1 IM - GM Stany, GM Swayams Mishra and IM S Satyapragyan - and three well known trainers, have come together to launch ChessEnrich - homework and assignment based chess platform. This time I wanted to know the story behind it: how the idea came, why three busy coaches decided to build it together, and why it is priced the way it is. Here is our conversation.
Video: ChessBase India
